hero.headline: From physical models to inspectable research tools.
hero.summary: I am a physics M.S. student at National Central University working on superconducting circuits. I study how physical models become trustworthy numerical results and build research tools that make models, simulation workflows, and results inspectable.

about: I work from physical assumptions through circuit and electromagnetic models to results that can be inspected and compared. Research workflows matter to me because they keep those steps connected.

I collaborate with AI agents to explore approaches, draft implementations, and organize documentation. I then use physical reasoning, numerical checks, and comparisons with published and other existing work to examine the assumptions, methods, and results.
summary: Physics M.S. student at National Central University; B.S. in Physics, 2026.
Works across superconducting-circuit modeling, electromagnetic simulation, and RF/microwave network analysis.
Builds research software and technical reading systems that make complex work easier to inspect.

expertise.title: Computational Electromagnetics & FEM
expertise.text: Derive weak formulations, basis functions, and matrix discretizations from electromagnetic and electrostatic governing equations; examine how materials, boundary conditions, meshes, and convergence affect fields and derived quantities.

expertise.title: RF/Microwave Network Analysis
expertise.text: Use multiport S-, Y-, and Z-parameters and their conversions; account for port definitions, reference impedances, and terminations when interpreting reflection and transmission.

expertise.title: Superconducting Circuit Modeling
expertise.text: Connect nodal admittance, modes, and poles to circuit coupling and energy-relaxation questions.

bullets.label: Framed the physical model
bullets.text: Applied an admittance-based formulation to describe floating-qubit coupling paths and make the energy-relaxation mechanism explicit enough for analytical and numerical review.

bullets.label: Cross-checked assumptions
bullets.text: Compared quasi-static extraction with full-wave finite-element simulation to identify where model assumptions stayed consistent and where numerical differences could arise.

research.title: Layout-to-FEM Research Workflow
research.meta: Research data generation through simulation automation

bullets.label: Built an iteration loop
bullets.text: Developed a data-generation workflow from GDSII layout to FEM simulation, connected to parametric design tooling so layout changes could become solver-ready experiments more quickly.

bullets.label: Mapped circuit parameters
bullets.text: Linked lumped circuit models to Hamiltonian-level quantities around coupling strength and ZZ interaction space, enabling targeted scans for calibration-sensitive parameters.

practice: Used National Center for High-performance Computing (NCHC) resources and mesh-refinement studies to compare solver cost, numerical differences, and reliability.
Helped maintain a lab Synology NAS and maintained a personal TrueNAS/Docker environment for research data, backups, and local compute.

hero.headline: 從物理模型走向可檢查的研究工具。
hero.role: 中央大學物理所碩士生 · 超導量子電路
hero.summary: 我在國立中央大學攻讀物理碩士，研究超導量子電路。我關心物理模型如何變成可信的數值結果，也建立讓模型、模擬流程與結果能被檢查的研究工具。

about: 我從物理假設出發，透過電路與電磁模型走向可檢查、可比較的結果。研究工作流的重要性，在於讓這些步驟彼此連接，而非留下孤立的數值。
我會與 AI agent 協作，探索不同做法、草擬實作並整理文件；接著用物理理解、數值檢查，以及與論文和其他既有成果的交叉比對，檢視假設、方法與結果是否合理。
summary: 國立中央大學物理所碩士生；2026 年取得物理學學士學位。
研究超導量子電路，結合電磁模擬、電路建模與射頻／微波網路分析。
建立科學軟體與技術閱讀系統，讓複雜工作更容易檢查與理解。

expertise.title: 計算電磁學與有限元素法
expertise.text: 從電磁與靜電問題的控制方程推導弱形式、基底函數與矩陣離散化，並檢視材料、邊界條件、網格及收斂如何影響場解與後續物理量。

expertise.title: 射頻與微波網路分析
expertise.text: 運用多埠 S、Y、Z 參數及其轉換，考慮埠定義、參考阻抗與終端條件對反射和傳輸結果的影響。

expertise.title: 超導電路建模
expertise.text: 將節點導納、模態與極點分析連到電路耦合及能量弛豫問題。

research.title: 浮動量子位元能量弛豫研究
research.meta: 學士論文，國立中央大學

bullets.label: 建立物理模型
bullets.text: 應用 admittance-based formulation 描述浮動量子位元的耦合路徑，讓能量弛豫機制能被分析推導與數值模擬共同檢查。

bullets.label: 交叉檢查假設
bullets.text: 比較準靜態萃取與全波有限元素模擬，確認模型假設在不同方法下的一致性，並辨識可能造成數值差異的位置。

research.title: Layout-to-FEM 研究工作流
research.meta: 透過模擬自動化產生研究資料

bullets.label: 建立迭代循環
bullets.text: 開發從 GDSII layout 到 FEM 模擬的資料產生工作流，並串接參數化設計工具，讓 layout 變更能更快形成可進 solver 的實驗。

bullets.label: 映射電路參數
bullets.text: 將集總電路模型連到 Hamiltonian 層級的耦合強度與 ZZ interaction space，使參數掃描能聚焦在校準敏感的電路量。

practice: 運用國家高速網路與計算中心（NCHC）資源，並透過 mesh refinement 比較求解成本、數值差異與可靠性。
協助維護實驗室 Synology NAS，並維護個人 TrueNAS／Docker 環境，用於研究資料、備份與本地運算。
